body.heading: Where in the world is Democratic Republic of the Congo?
paragraphs: Democratic Republic of the Congo is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Democratic Republic of the Congo is Kinshasa.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Democratic Republic of the Congo speak French, Lingala and Kongo.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Democratic Republic of the Congo is the Congolese franc.

body.heading: How big is Democratic Republic of the Congo?
paragraphs: Democratic Republic of the Congo covers about 2,345,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Mozambique.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Virunga, Africa's oldest national park, protects mountain gorillas on misty volcano slopes, and even has an active volcano with a glowing lava lake.
The Congo is one of the world's great rivers. From Kinshasa's riverbanks you can watch boats of every size crossing to Brazzaville on the far shore.
